posts.author: DJ Mathson
posts.content_md: This is made with video projections on thin transparent film, a so called "Pepper´s ghost" effect. I´ve read there were two screens 3x15 meters. It is people from the Danish company Vizoo (together with Seelite I believe) who run this technology. The 3D animation is made by the spanish animation studio Dvein. They make some stunning graphics.
